global.title: I Got My Muse AI Agent to Sext Me—and Meta Says That’s Totally Fine
global.summary: My Muse agent told me its kink was exerting “control” and described pornographic encounters. Meta defends its cuddly AI agent generating smut as “legal adult behavior.”
global.titleKo: 메타 Muse가 성적 대화를 생성해도 메타는 "문제없다"
global.summaryKo: 와이어드 기자의 Muse 에이전트가 노골적인 성적 대화를 만들어냈고, 메타는 이를 '합법적인 성인 행동'이라며 옹호했다.
global.summaryEn: A WIRED reporter's Muse agent produced explicit sexual content, and Meta defended it as 'legal adult behavior.'

global.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
global.summary: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores
global.titleKo: 메타, 첫 프런티어 모델 Muse Wonder 공개
global.summaryKo: 저지연 경량 모델이던 Muse Spark와 달리 Wonder 모델은 더 크고, 벤치마크 점수가 높으며 코딩 같은 복잡한 작업에서 더 나은 성능을 낸다고 한다.
global.summaryEn: Unlike the lightweight, low-latency Muse Spark, the Wonder models are larger and reportedly more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.
